text: For these reasons, this study adopted the KJ method to analyze the data, and the specific steps of this process are as follows. Coding: representative statements were selected, condensed into concise entries, summarised, and coded. Record card: Transfer the coded quotes to a small card (about 3 cm *3 cm, cut from A4 paper). Theme extraction: (1) All members read the cards five times to determine which are related to the theme. (2) After understanding the contents of each card, group those with similar contents, summarize them and add an ?A title?. (3) The grouped ?A title? group is regarded as a whole and put together with the small cards of its group. (The number of small cards in a group shall not exceed half of the initial number of cards in this round). Then re-group the small cards with similar contents, summarize them and add a ?B title?. (4) By analogy, groups of headings B, C, and D are formed in turn, ultimately extracting six major themes. For the six identified themes, physical cards were created and iteratively rearranged on a background sheet until their spatial arrangement reflected logical relationships. Various symbols were then used to annotate the connections among themes.
